B fix r2:save-perf:
All 3 save-perf issues are fixed and re-tested in headless Chrome on my snapshot build (port 5198, every /api/ call intercepted). `npm run build` passes and no commits were made.

Results:
- **"GLTF texture loads are not retried under load; console errors at boot"**: fixed.
  - The cause: three's GLTFLoader catches a failed texture and loads the model without it, so the existing retry never saw the failure.
  - New `loadGltf` in `src/util.js` gives each attempt its own LoadingManager. If any file fails, the attempt throws and the existing retry runs it again.
  - While retries remain, "Couldn't load texture" is logged as a warning. After the last try the model is kept and one error lists the missing files.
  - `src/nature.js`, `src/animals.js` and `src/people.js` now use it.
  - Test: 3 injected bark texture failures were retried, then all 155 bark meshes had their texture, with 0 console errors. A texture that never loads still lets the game boot, with one error per model.
- **"Slow first save request with empty localStorage hides Continue; 'Begin the story' then deletes the database save without asking"**: fixed.
  - `src/save.js`: `loadGame` sets `saveState.unknown` on a timeout, network error or 5xx. Only a real server answer (data or data:null) now counts as "no save". With no browser copy the first wait is 8 s instead of 4.
  - `deleteGame({server})` can now skip the DELETE request.
  - `src/main.js`: while the state is unknown, the title says "Looking for your saved story…" and keeps retrying. If the save arrives late, "Continue · day N" comes back.
  - "Begin the story" now asks for confirmation while the state is unknown. A new game started then never sends DELETE.
  - `server/db.mjs`: opens that are already in progress are shared, and the new `warmDb` opens both stores when the server starts (`vite.config.js`, `server/serve.mjs`).
  - Tests:
    - With a 20 s delay, the confirm appears. Declining keeps the title with no DELETE. When the save arrives, "Continue · day 14" is back.
    - Accepting starts a new game with no DELETE.
    - With a 5 s delay, Continue shows at boot.
- **"Shared materials across instanced and plain meshes swap shader programs on every draw (top frame-time and garbage hotspot)"**: fixed.
  - `src/nature.js` has a new `plainMat(m)`, a cached copy of a material for plain meshes. Landmarks in `src/landmarks.js` and the flower and path decor in `src/entities.js` use it, so they no longer share the instanced materials.
  - `src/world.js`: resource fields always write an instance colour (white when untinted), so the shared white material has one variant. The per-frame decor loop compares squared distances.
  - `src/main.js`: adaptive resolution changes at most once every 2.5 s.
  - Measured on the day-14 save at home (2,8) at 11:00:

| | Old build | New build |
|---|---|---|
| Materials drawn with mixed variants | 4 | 0 |
| Program lookups per frame | 22 | 0 |
| JS allocation | 28.7 MB/s | 19.7 MB/s |

  - Screenshots of the Great Tree and home show no visual change.

**Extra fix:** your progress note said the `wS[e] is not a function` crash belonged to this fixer. `makeStructure` in `src/entities.js` now warns and places an empty, non-solid marker for an unknown structure kind instead of throwing. All current kinds have builders, and the save load already drops unknown kinds.

**Playthrough check:** `tools/test/steps/play.json` ran with 0 errors and 10 fails. All 10 come from the story going herd -> smoke: the inserted mature chapters (on by default) take a different path than the script expects. That is workflow A's area, so I don't think my changes caused it.
